method.grid: 25 vertical + 15 horizontal lines; original pixel coordinates, no image rescaling.
method.localization: 11px cross-axis blackhat; +/-5px search; centroid radius3; contrast >=20/255; robust cubic guidance for association only.
method.masking: Exclude intersections +/-5px using opposite-family cubic guidance; 8px endpoint margin.
method.fitting: Orthogonal TLS of measured intensity centroids; no final straight-line residual outlier rejection. Pooled RMS uses all retained points.
method.adaptations: Chart ROI, seed bands, peak separation12px, seed anchors and proportional central guidance support updated for smaller new chart. Horizontal guidance uses central60% in both images to avoid initial raw H01 crossing drift at x846. Final measured points cover full line; main localization parameters unchanged.
method.limitation: Pixel image residual includes paper/printing/optics/correction/sampling/localization; not physical mm accuracy or FPGA-only error. Different chart scale from previous pair.
